# review security issues

Go through the repository's [GitHub security tab](https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/security) — Dependabot alerts on the `toolset` Go module, whose large dependency graph (octosql, cloud SDKs) attracted advisories — and resolve or dismiss each.
